script.title: Forest Moon Galaxy Base, 1979
script.description: Ewok-built Classic Space: timber-wing glider, amber-window treetop huts, blue radar crowns and wooden aerial walkways. Three rooted trees carry a connected forest village, with opening doors, accessible stairs, printed computers and a removable spacecraft.
